sequences.description: Large hero image with 'Relief' branding graphic, product name 'RINVOQ (upadacitinib)' with 'once-daily pill' text, and large heading about taming symptoms
Introductory text block stating 'RINVOQ helps heal your grateful skin in two ways' with subtext about reducing inflammation and soothing eczema

Three columns side-by-side, each with heading and supporting text: 'Fast Relief' (symptoms in 2 days), 'Rapid & Significant Skin Clearance' (visible results in 2 weeks), 'Long-term Results' (maintained skin clearance)
Heading 'Select Important Safety Information' with decorative gold brushstroke, followed by safety warning text in black box
Poll component with 'QUICK POLL' logo, question 'Where is your next dermatologist visit?', and three radio button options
Heading 'Meet RINVOQ patients like Maddy' with introduction text and 'Meet patients' button
Patient image on right side with yellow brushstroke background, name 'Maddy' and descriptive text about her eczema journey
Two-column layout: left side has 'TAKE THIS QUIZ' text with brushstroke styling and quiz question dropdown, right side has lifestyle image
Large 'ISI' heading with decorative brushstroke, followed by paragraphs of important safety information text and 'What is the most important information' section with bullet points
Complete Important Safety Information with multiple sections including boxed warnings, risk information, and clinical study details presented as flowing text with headings and bullet lists

notes: Similar structure to homepage but with condition-specific content
Hero has condition-specific messaging instead of condition selector
Three-column benefits layout is unique to condition pages
Poll and quiz components are interactive elements
Patient testimonial section with image and story
Extensive ISI content spans two sections
